issues.title: Jordan launches airstrikes in Syria after church attack
issues.title_en: Jordan launches airstrikes in Syria after church attack
issues.summary: Jordan carried out airstrikes Monday (October 27) evening against armed groups in Syria in retaliation for Friday’s attack on a Greek Orthodox Church in the southern Jordanian city of Karak that killed nine people, the Jordanian air force said in a statement. Syrian authorities said at least six people were killed.
